packages.name: unic
packages.description: LeNK's unified plugin bundle: 9 skills + 5 slash commands. Installed as one umbrella 'unic' plugin via the lenk-marketplace registry.

plugins.name: unic-vue
plugins.description: Nuxt 3 + Vue 2 Options API patterns, backend integration, predefined Control/Grid/Panel components.

plugins.name: unic-sql
plugins.description: PostgreSQL SQL writing conventions for UNIC projects (functions, views, tables, queries).

plugins.name: unic-api
plugins.description: LeNK/UNIC backend HTTP API contract — endpoints, conditions grammar, GZIP envelope, schema namespacing, auth flow.

plugins.name: unic-architect
plugins.description: System architect for designing clean, scalable, maintainable systems.

plugins.name: unic-debugger
plugins.description: Root cause analysis and bug fixing.

plugins.name: unic-orchestrator
plugins.description: Workflow coordination for complex multi-phase tasks.

plugins.name: unic-researcher
plugins.description: Codebase exploration and external technology research.

plugins.name: unic-security-auditor
plugins.description: Security expert for OWASP Top 10, auth/authz flows, secrets handling, and hardening.

plugins.name: document
plugins.description: Generate or update documentation for the specified code

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Provide a high-level explanation of the current file or specific code blocks

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Suggest and implement refactorings for the specified code

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Perform a comprehensive code review of the current changes or specific files

plugins.name: test
plugins.description: Generate tests for the current code or specific functions
